propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings into binding_lifecycle which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the freeze no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its mutation-detection blast radius narrowed and would not catch regressions in clear_absent timestamp stamping.
Patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle restores the oracle's reach to catch unconditional updated_at stamping in moved binding operations.
The only binding_store_mod-targeted patch whose subject moved to binding_lifecycle during RP-02 S2 is the _now_iso freeze at line 311; no other moved-subject patches exist in the file.
